build_seq_generation_head: build a SeqGenerationHead with a decoder config and label smoothing loss function
forward_decoder_output: run forward pass through SeqGenerationHead with input_ids and encoder hidden states
calculate_seq_gen_loss: calculate sequence generation loss using shifted prediction scores and masked labels
predict_with_beam_search: generate text predictions using beam search with configurable num_beams and max_length
predict_with_nucleus_sampling: generate text predictions using nucleus sampling with top_p filtering and repetition penalty
